purpose: Define the controlled admission gate for a corrected or replacement property evidence fixture before dependent revalidation may execute.
required_conditions: Source authority is verified when source-derived.
Retrieval/source dates are recorded when applicable.
Legal period is preserved when applicable.
Substantive meaning is not altered by redaction.
Fixture remains explicitly synthetic or source-derived.
Fixture remains isolated from production legal evidence.
Approval is recorded before dependent revalidation.

current_state.reason: No corrected or replacement fixture has yet been admitted and approved.

guardrails: Do not infer approval from technical validation.
A source-derived fixture is still a controlled test fixture unless separately admitted as production evidence through the appropriate evidence process.
No fixture can establish real property ownership, title, boundary or other real-world property fact.
Passing this gate does not verify Irish property law.
Passing this gate does not authorize publication.
